review.headline: Steady 16 km long run at 5:47/km, inside the easy band, with even splits and HR in the low 140s.
observations: Distance 15.995 km against a 16 km plan, covered at 5:47/km average, mid-way through the 5:11-6:13/km easy range.
Splits were nearly identical, 5:48 for 14 of 16 km, with the only variation at km 9 (5:38) and km 16 (5:48 on 0.995 km), so pacing was controlled throughout.
Average HR 142 (max 145) with no visible drift across the run, consistent with a comfortably aerobic effort.
Efficiency of 1.218 is slightly below the 1.273 from the 8.99 km easy run on 11-05, but the longer distance and similar HR make that a minor difference rather than a concern.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so effort is judged from pace and HR only.
No fueling information was recorded, so the race-day fueling part of the plan cannot be confirmed.
